name: Default
shortDescription: Open source payments switch with the Hyperswitch API, Control Center dashboard, PostgreSQL and Redis behind one domain.

alerts.message: Sign-up stays open: anyone who can reach the URL can create an account and merchant. Create your own account right after the first deploy.
Card data is kept by the built-in mock locker, which is meant for testing. Set up the Hyperswitch card vault before processing real card payments.
